docTitle: NoorWaqt — Nin waati la, yɔrɔ dɔ la, mɔgɔ dɔ bɛ seli kɛ
docDesc: Diɲɛ seli ja ɲɛnama: a filɛ ka seli yeelen bɔ dugukolo kan ka tugu su ni tile danfara sira kɔ. NoorWaqt ye Silamɛya porogaramu ye min bɛ kalantaa fila ta, min dilanna musow ka batoli kɔrɔ, ani fiqhi jatebɔ bɛɛ bɛ kɛ i yɛrɛ ka minɛn kɔnɔ.
heroTitle: Nin waati la, diɲɛ fan bɛɛ la, Silamɛw bɛ seli kɛ.
heroLead: I tɛ seli kɛ i kelen na abada. Dugukolo yɛlɛma ka yeelen filɛ a bɛ taa su ni tile danfara sira kan — dugu o dugu min donna a ka seli waati la, o bɛ yeelen bɔ.
heroLive: Sisan dugu {n} bɛ seli waati la
barsNote: Nin ja kan dugu {total} la, jamana ni yɔrɔ {countries} kɔnɔ
timeTitle: Tile kuturu kelen bila ka taa ɲɛ
timeLead: Waati sira sama, walima ka digi 'a bila' kan. Lɛrɛ mugan ni naani kɔnɔ, seli yeelen bɛ dugukolo lamini siɲɛ kelen dafalen.
cityTitle: I ka dugu fana ka yeelen bɔ
cityLead: I ka dugu ɲini, walima ka sira di navigatɛri ma a ka i yɔrɔ dɔn. Waati bɛɛ bɛ jate i yɛrɛ ka minɛn kɔnɔ — foyi tɛ ci yɔrɔ si la.
cityDenied: Yɔrɔ sira banna — ɲinini fana bɛ baara kelen kɛ.
cityUnsupported: Nin navigatɛri tɛ yɔrɔdɔn kɛ. Ɲinini kɛ.
cityNoResult: Dugu si ma sɔrɔ. Sɛbɛnni wɛrɛ lajɛ.
cityNear: A jiralen bɛ dugu surunman {city} kan (a bɛ se ka kɛ km {km} ye)
ramadanTitle: Sunkalo la, diɲɛ bɛɛ bɛ sun ɲɔgɔn fɛ
ramadanLead: Ni tile bɛ taa tilebin fɛ, dugu kɔfɛ dugu bɛ sun daminɛ — ani dugu kɔfɛ dugu bɛ sun tigɛ. Ni minnɔgɔ b'i la halibi, mɔgɔ dɔ bɛ dugukolo fan dɔ la min ye ji fɔlɔ min ka ban.
ramadanNote: Umm al-Qura jate kalantaa de sinsinnen. Don yɛrɛyɛrɛw bɛ tugu i sigida kalo yeli kɔ, ani u bɛ se ka danfara ni tile kelen ye.
eidTitle: Seliba bɛ bɔ kɔrɔn fɛ, dugu kelen-kelen
eidLead: Seliba tɛ se diɲɛ bɛɛ ma sekondi kelen na. A bɛ daminɛ Pasifiki kɔgɔji la ka taa tilebin fɛ, ka dugu o dugu yeelen bɔ a ɲɔgɔn kɔ — Jakarta, Daka, Kayiro, Istanbul, London, New York.
eidEve: A bɛ daminɛ sufɛ tɛmɛnen fitiri la
womenTitle: Nin dugukolo mɔgɔw tilancɛ ka batoli ma deli ka jate kosɛbɛ
womenLead: Seli porogaramu bɛɛ ka ca bɛ miiri ko a baaracɛla ye cɛ ye. NoorWaqt ma deli ka miiri ten, kabini kodu sɛbɛn fɔlɔ.
women1Title: Fiqhi minɛn min dilanna musow ye
women1Desc: Sisitɛmu min bɛ tugu mazahabu caman kɔ — Hanafi ni tɔw — o bɛ i yɛrɛ ka kalo taama sɛbɛnw kalan, ka danfara don hayidi ni istihada cɛ, ka bilali, kaza ani hakilijigin labɛn. I tɛna fiqhi gafe yɛlɛma tugun kalo o kalo.
women2Title: I ka kalo taama tɛ yɔrɔ lankolon ye
women2Desc: Seli bilali kɔrɔ tɛ ko batoli jɔra. O tilew la, porogaramu bɛ yɛlɛma ka taa zikiri ni duba cogoya la, walisa tile o tile ka a yɛrɛ cogo sɔrɔ.
women3Desc: Hijira ni Miladiya ɲɔgɔn kɛrɛfɛ, ani Duha fɛnɛtiri min bɛ yɔrɔ jɛ waati fila ma minnu man ɲi — tile bɔli ni tilegan.
women4Desc: Don o don wiridi, juma seli, kalo sunw — bɛɛ fɔlisen kelen kɔnɔ.
privacyTitle: Nin foyi tɛ bɔ i ka telefɔni kɔnɔ
privacyLead: Kalo taama kunnafoni ye gundo kunnafoni ye kosɛbɛ. NoorWaqt ka fiqhi jatebɔ bɛɛ bɛ kɛ minɛn kɔnɔ. Jate si tɛ, sankolo sync tɛ, cili tɛ.
privacy1d: I ka sɛbɛnw ni kiitiw bɛ to minɛn kɔnɔ. An yɛrɛ tɛ sɛrwɛri sɔrɔ min tun bɛ se k'u mara.
privacy2: A bɛ baara kɛ interinɛti kɔ
privacy2d: Kurana 7.3MB bɛ na porogaramu kɔnɔ. A bɛ baara kɛ pankurun cogoya la fana.
privacy3d: A sigi ka daminɛ. Telefɔni nimɔrɔ tɛ, imɛli tɛ.
privacyWeb: Nin ja fana bɛ baara kɛ o cogo kelen na: dugu {n} bɛɛ bɛ jate i ka navigatɛri kɔnɔ, i yɔrɔ tɛ bɔ i ka minɛn kɔnɔ. Nka ɛntɛrinɛti sɛbɛnnifura bɛ jigin, ani ni i sɔnna, bɔyɔrɔ jatebla fana.
dlTitle: Nin yeelen bila i ka bɔrɔ kɔnɔ
dlLead: Android bɛ beta dayɛlɛlen na. A ye fu ye, piblisite tɛ, sanni tɛ.
dlSideload: I ka kan ka sira di ko a bɛ se ka sigi ka bɔ yɔrɔ dɔnbaliw la. Sisan, 64-bit (arm64-v8a) sugandi dɔrɔn de bɔra — minɛn kɔrɔw 32-bit ma dɛmɛ fɔlɔ. iOS sugandi bɛ sira kan.
footerTag: I ka seli. I ka waati. I ka diɲɛ.
footerPrivacy: Porogaramu bɛ baara kɛ i ka minɛn kɔnɔ. An tɛ i yɛrɛ ka sɛbɛnw lajɛ.
footerCalc: Nin ja waatiw jatera i ka navigatɛri kɔnɔ interinɛti kɔ, hakilijigin dama ye. I sigida misiri kɔlɔsi.
shareFail: A ma se ka mara — digi ja kan ka mɛn.
consentText: An bɛ se ka Google Analytics kɛ ka bɔyɔrɔw jate wa? A bɛ butɔn minnu digi i fɛ ani dugu min ɲini nin ɲɛ kan, o bɛ sɛbɛn. Seli waatiw bɛ jate i ka minɛn kɔnɔ tuma bɛɛ.
